title: Herbie
transcription:
Herbie
Action song

spoken, with slobbering clap.
One day,
I was skippin' home from school,
skippin' home from school,
skippin' home from school,
ung!
And there was mamma, and there was
papa, and there was sister,
and there was brother, and there was
Herbie, the family pet, "Chah!"
And he was this big, this big
(make small indication with hand)

And the next day I was skippin' home
from school,
skippin' home from school, skippin'
home from school.
ung!
And there was mamma, and there was
papa, and there was sister,
but there was no brother!
And I was so mad!
and there was Herbie,
the family pet, "Chah!"
And he was this big, this big
(make slightly bigger indication with hand)

continue with sequence, substituting one
family member each time while indicating
that Herbie was bigger. When there is no
mamma, say in unison:

And then Herbie let out the biggest
belch I've ever heard in my entire life!
ung!
And there was mamma, and there was
papa, and there was sister,
and there was brother,
Herbie, the family pet, "Chah!"
And he was this big, this big!
(make small indication with hand)
